title: EPSs and Exopolysaccharides Characterization and Production
summary: This cluster revolves around Exopolysaccharides (EPSs) and its characterization, production, and antiproliferative activity. EPSs are analyzed by GC-MS and FT-IR, and have free radical scavenging activity similar to hyaluronic acid. They are produced by various microorganisms, including Bacillus atrophaeus WYZ, Ganoderma applanatum, and Rhodotorula mucilaginosa CICC 33013. EPSs exhibit antiproliferative activity against MCF-7 and MDCK cell lines. Additionally, Rhodosporidium babjevae is characterized by Exopolysaccharides and produces EPSs, while Golubev is associated with Rhodosporidium babjevae and studied EPSs.
